name: ilostat-mcp-server
description: Search ILOSTAT labour indicators, query and compare series, build country profiles, run SQL.

ILOSTAT_CATALOG_REFRESH_HOURS.title: Catalog refresh interval (hours)
ILOSTAT_CATALOG_REFRESH_HOURS.description: Hours between checks of the ILOSTAT tables of contents (1–168).

ILOSTAT_MAX_ROWS.title: Row ceiling per query
ILOSTAT_MAX_ROWS.description: Ceiling on the rows one query may return or stage (1,000–1,000,000).

ILOSTAT_PREVIEW_CHARS.title: Inline preview budget (characters)
ILOSTAT_PREVIEW_CHARS.description: Inline preview budget in serialized characters; a larger result is staged as a dataframe.

ILOSTAT_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.title: Response cache TTL (seconds)
ILOSTAT_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS.description: Seconds a small upstream data response stays cached (0 disables the cache).

ILOSTAT_DATASET_TTL_SECONDS.title: Dataframe TTL (seconds)
ILOSTAT_DATASET_TTL_SECONDS.description: Per-table TTL for staged dataframes, in seconds (at least 60).

ILOSTAT_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.title: Enable dataframe drop
ILOSTAT_DATAFRAME_DROP_ENABLED.description: Expose ilostat_dataframe_drop; staged dataframes otherwise expire on their TTL.
